rule.label: game icon
rule.goal: create a purpose-designed icon that communicates the game's identity at small size
reference_rules: prefer a representative character, creature, vehicle, core symbol, or existing icon as the reference
if the reference is a gameplay screenshot, extract the most recognizable subject or gameplay symbol instead of copying the screenshot layout
inherit the subject's identity, silhouette, key structure, and signature colors, but do not inherit UI, HUD, buttons, prices, cards, or text
content_constraints: do not add rounded corners, an app-icon frame, button shell, sticker shell, or base plate
prompt_rules: use one unique focal subject or one core symbol
make the subject dominate the frame and remain immediately recognizable at small size
use a centered, near-centered, close-up, or compact symmetrical composition
use clean continuous shapes and remove unstable tiny details, jagged edges, and irrelevant background clutter
keep the game's native visual language, including pixel or strongly stylized treatment when present
let the background support the subject without becoming the primary focus
text_rules: do not include the game title, letters, words, labels, or other text
forbidden_elements: HUD, buttons, health bars, numbers, price labels, cards, grid UI, or other interface fragments
subject that is too small to identify
generic flat UI icon treatment unrelated to the game's native style

manual_checks: do not add rounded corners, an app-icon frame, button shell, sticker shell, or base plate
next_steps: 图片仅保存在本地，CLI 未上传或修改资料字段。
请先确认候选图；确认后再执行候选项中的 upload_command 上传到素材库。
